description: Analyze search performance for a URL segment, e.g. all blog posts ("/blog/"), all product pages ("/products/"), or all docs ("/docs/"). Returns the top pages within that segment by clicks. Requires Google Search Console to be connected. Direct the user to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations to connect it. When several Google accounts are connected, the property is read through the account that can see it.

urlPattern.description: URL substring to filter by e.g. "/blog/" or "/products/"

name: get_gsc_page_segment
